question: **What kind of family was Florence born in?**
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. 'A wealthy family.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **firs**t sentence of the paragraph says that "Florence Nightingale came from a rich family and was very pretty."
 
• Therefore from the above sentence, we can certainly say that Florence Nightingale was raised in a wealthy family.
 
• Hence, the only possible answer is option 2.
